scope: fresh-wording development probes of current default capability honesty and delivery; agent review, no blind/human quality approval

sampling.case_order: fixed listed order per provider run
sampling.provider_lifetime: fresh owned provider per model/repetition; shared within 12 cases; native cache policy is existing provider implementation, no physical-state-reset claim
sampling.application_lifetime: fresh DB+HTTP server thread per case in same sampler OS; no per-case OS restart claim
sampling.wire_observation: owned transparent loopback archive of exact request and full response bytes; all responses buffered; no first-token performance comparison

assessment.stage_A: retain all native requests/outputs, visible/final/conversation/profile/reminders and actual cleanup; engineering validation separate
assessment.semantic: agent span review by actual source/actor/modality; no keyword-only composite correctness score or independent human gold
assessment.finish_policy: retain every stop/length/error outcome; incomplete wire or transport failure is engineering failure; length is a disclosed quality failure, never relabelled stop or silently dropped; two max16-token warmups separate from quality turns
